banditlab: Multi-Armed Bandit Experimentation and Policy Comparison

Source: R/banditlab-package.R
banditlab-package.Rd

A framework for simulating, comparing and extending multi-armed bandit algorithms. The package separates three concerns:

Details

  • Environments generate rewards: bandit_bernoulli(), bandit_gaussian(), bandit_custom().

  • Policies select arms and learn from rewards: policy_random(), policy_greedy(), policy_epsilon_greedy(), policy_etc(), policy_ucb1(), policy_thompson().

  • Experiments connect the two: run_experiment() runs replicated simulations with reproducible per-replicate random number streams and returns tidy results for analysis with summary(), as_tibble(), compare_policies() and ggplot2::autoplot().

Custom policies plug into the same engine through three documented S3 generics: policy_state(), select_arm() and update_state(). See vignette("custom-policies", package = "banditlab").

Regret metrics follow exact definitions documented in regret_definitions.
